source.original_MDP: MDPPCH with Task(learning_regime=do); original public-only adapter and upstream unmodified

user_authorization.source: Operator confirmed proposed prospective test on 2026-11-16 in this conversation

cohorts.train_policy: fixed public-only behavior/control policy selected before current reward, 64 original virgin episodes; shared same public TRAIN outcomes across all fitted candidate/controls
cohorts.held_policy: each arm separately receives 64 distinct virgin original episodes; selected public action and real reward visible only after action, one source first-use per seed
cohorts.transfer_policy: each arm 24 distinct virgin episodes from an independently attested mechanism FAMILY different from TRAIN and HELD; seed-only novelty is NOT family-transfer

learners.native: unchanged CVH02 36-slot tokenless 4-step earned memory, public-only
learners.fourcell: unchanged CVH06 4-cell fit from exact public rewards, public-only
learners.recurrent: CVH08 SourceIndependentPublicTrainRNN exact 8 unit Elman 48 epoch BPTT on 64 virgin TRAIN public episodes, no held training
learners.selection_order: TRAIN all 64 first once, fit all learned arms and seal cold source and train hashes BEFORE any held or transfer outcome; each separate arm has independent policy state, fixed original action budget, record all actual do and rewards
learners.held_return_updates: within episode previous public reward can update online policy; learning between held episodes must be frozen/standardized and separately reported. No held outcomes included in pre-test fit or model-selection thresholds.

metrics.primary: Mean earned public binary reward per actually executed original do in held corpus; native must exceed highest score among fully trained real-source matched controls
metrics.CI: fixed-seed 10000 resamples of independent episode clusters by arm; compute native minus maximum control in each replicate, empirical 2.5th percentile >0.0; no post-result retuning
metrics.secondary: 24 virgin transfer episodes per arm from independently verified distinct causal mechanism family, earned-reward and cold-retention interference, reproducibility. No source-family proof => transfer UNVERIFIED and scientific_pass false.
metrics.pass_all: native held gain >0.05 and lower CI>0 against strongest qualified control, real novel causal family transfer independently passed and reproducible, exact source first-use/owner custody, all platform full regression and security controls pass

current_gate.purpose: Implement source-only owner seed lease validation, first-use denial, source-independent prospective outcome scorer and negative test controls; do not consume original actions
